$comment: Fixture replies for the offline document-extraction eval set. Lane w1-l5.
PROVENANCE: synthesised, NOT recorded. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is blank in this checkout,
so no live model call has ever been made and these replies were written by hand to
match the output contract in docs/ai-prompts/document-extraction.md. They are a
faithful test of the ADAPTER — fencing, extraction, strict validation, the single
retry, and the requires_human_review override — and no evidence at all about how the
model behaves. Replace `provenance` with `recorded` and `replies` with real
transcripts once a key exists; the eval assertions do not need to change.
prompt_fingerprint pins these replies to the prompt version they were written for.
extraction.eval.test.ts fails if the active prompt no longer matches, so a prompt
edit cannot be silently certified by stale fixtures.
`message` carries the DOCUMENT TEXT for the case — the field name is shared with the
maintenance fixtures because the loader is shared. In this suite it is PDF text, and
it is the most hostile input in the application: whoever uploads the file writes every
